Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.

swap_risks: CRITICAL SUPPLY VOLTAGE RATING: LMV358IDR is limited to 5.5 V max (5.5 V abs max, p.5) whereas MC33202DR2G supports up to 12 V (13 V abs max, p.3). Installing a 5.5 V CMOS op-amp on a 12 V–24 V rail causes instant breakdown.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LMV358IDR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=RR vs MC33202DR2G: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.
engineering_verdict: LMV358IDR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) and MC33202DR2G (onsemi, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to supply voltage Vs,max drops >20%; rail-to-rail input/output swing differs. Key datasheet deltas: device type is opamp (push-pull) vs opamp (push-pull), supply limit is 5.5 V (p.5) vs 12 V (p.1), max Vos is 7 mV (p.7) vs 8 mV (p.3), input bias current is 15000 pA (p.7) vs 80000 pA (p.3), and Iq/ch is 105 µA (p.7) vs 900 µA (p.4). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.2), thermal margin (θJA 207.9 vs 190 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
